alert: Sonarr queue processing is CRASHING (imports frozen)
description: Sonarr's QueueService is throwing on every queue refresh, which freezes ALL imports — downloads finish in decypharr but never reach the library. Usually a torrent with a null/empty name in decypharr's qBit API.

filter.expression: service.name = 'sonarr' AND severity_text = 'ERROR' AND body CONTAINS 'QueueService failed'

annotations.description: List decypharr's torrents and delete any with an empty name: curl -s http://decypharr:8282/api/v2/torrents/info | jq '.[] | select(.name == null or .name == "")'. Then run Sonarr's RefreshMonitoredDownloads command.
